messages:
Maya (Design): quick follow-up from the lab: the structured-output / tool-calling preview in Playground looks tidy but keyboard users are getting stuck on the Close button instead of reaching tools or arg inputs.
Eli (DevEx): can you paste repro steps? is this the compact side panel or the full preview modal?
Maya (Design): compact side panel. steps: open fn def -> Preview -> Tab. focus lands on Close and cycles; arrows don't move across tool items.
Suri (Frontend): sounds like our focus-lock initialFocus default. small fix: set initialFocus to the tool list container and implement roving tabindex so Arrow keys move selection.
Jared (A11y): yes. add role=listbox on the list, role=option on items, aria-activedescendant for the active item, and an sr-only keyboard hint connected via aria-describedby. ensure Esc closes and focus returns. Also announce panel opening for SR users.
Priya (PM): product constraint: avoid autofocus on mobile (keyboard pop). prefer bottom-sheet on small widths and require explicit tap to focus. prioritize keyboard + SR fixes; truncation of run-history names can be follow-up.
Eli (DevEx): rollout plan: 1) change initialFocus to .tool-list (small PR) 2) add aria attrs + sr-only hint (Suri) 3) Storybook + e2e keyboard tests (CI-Bot) 4) ship behind feature flag for a11y lab.
CI-Bot: added tests PLG-KEY-501 (panel focus order) and PLG-KEY-502 (roving list navigation).
Maya (Design): copy tweak: header from "Preview invocation" -> "Invocation preview" with a tiny info icon. visible hint short: "Tab or ↑↓ to navigate"; full instruction is sr-only.
Jared (A11y): icon OK if keyboardable and linked to sr-only via aria-describedby. screen readers should read the full sentence from the sr-only node.
Suri (Frontend): i'll add the icon, sr-only text, and a Storybook story demonstrating keyboard-only flow. will include unit tests for focus order.
Eli (DevEx): PR will be opened and tagged for review by @Suri and @Jared. plan to canary behind flag this week.
Maya (Design): thanks team 31f ping me for micro-copy polish once PR is up.
